name: a2a-rdf-extension
description: RDF Protocol Documents — an A2A extension (unofficial draft, per A2A spec §4.6): hash-pinned SHACL-bodied protocol documents negotiated once in natural language, then SHACL-validated RDF exchange in ordinary A2A Parts, with a fail-closed no-silent-downgrade rule and composition with ODRL delegation + Agent Authorization Credentials. Extension URI https://w3id.org/jeswr/a2a-rdf/v1. Candidate proposal to the LF A2A project; submission maintainer-gated.
tr: a2aproject governance (target, on proposal sponsorship — maintainer-gated)
